title: Rebuild the Card atom on Ant Design's real Card component internally, keeping CardProps and its behavior contract unchanged
objective: Owner-directed reversal of the already-recorded 'Card atom decision' in packages/ui/DECISIONS.md (Card was deliberately kept vendor-free because antd's Card 'contributed nothing beyond a <div>' for EntitySummary's needs, decided minutes earlier in this same session while building PreviewCard). Owner's stated motivation (via AskUserQuestion): general preference to leverage what antd/other libraries already provide instead of hand-building. Confirmed scope: Card's internals move to antd's real Card component; CardProps and every observable prop stays exactly as-is so EntitySummary and PreviewCard (both built on Card) need zero changes. Verified directly against the installed antd@6.5.2 package (node_modules/.pnpm/antd@6.5.2.../antd/es/card/Card.d.ts, not assumed): antd 6's Card has a 'semantic DOM' styles={{root,body,...}} + variant='borderless'|'outlined' API sufficient to reproduce every current visual effect. One real, unavoidable, explicitly-flagged consequence: antd's Card necessarily renders 'ant-card' (plus a css-in-js hash class) on its own root element -- there is no way to use the real component and suppress that. This breaks packages/ui/tests/ui.test.mjs's existing 'lets the Card atom own a complete selected canvas-node boundary' test, which currently asserts doesNotMatch(rootTag, /ant-/) on Card/EntitySummary's root -- that specific DOM-purity guarantee does not survive this reversal, even though the props contract does. Full design in the approved plan at C:\Users\PICHAU\.claude\plans\mellow-drifting-nova.md.
validations: DONE: verified antd's real Card API directly against the installed package before writing any code (node_modules/.pnpm/antd@6.5.2.../antd/es/card/Card.d.ts) rather than assuming -- confirmed the styles={{root,body,...}} semantic-DOM API and variant='borderless' exist and are sufficient, matching this repo's own established precedent (UI-002's risk note: 'the real installed package's own .d.ts files must be read directly').

DONE: rewrote packages/ui/src/atoms/card.tsx to render antd's Card internally with styles.root/styles.body carrying every value the old implementation computed by hand (background, border, borderRadius, boxShadow/glow, clipPath, cursor, height, overflow, width in styles.root; padding in styles.body) -- CardProps interface itself byte-for-byte unchanged. tsc --noEmit clean on the first attempt, including data-selected/data-shape/aria-label all being accepted directly on antd's Card component (verified, not assumed to work).

DONE: ran the existing test suite against the real new markup before touching any assertion, to see the actual failure surface rather than guess -- exactly 3 failures, all and only the doesNotMatch(rootTag, /ant-/) assertions in ui.test.mjs (Card's own test, EntitySummary's, and PreviewCard's); every other assertion (aria-label, content, data-selected, exact border/height/cursor style strings, tags, status) passed unchanged, concretely proving the props/behavior contract really did stay frozen through this reversal, exactly as the owner required.

DONE: updated the 3 affected tests to assert the new, real, deliberate contract (match(rootTag, /class="ant-card/) instead of doesNotMatch) rather than deleting the guarantee silently; renamed the no-longer-accurate 'renders a dependency-free bounded surface' test title. Full suite: 12/12 pass.

DONE: confirmed via api-check that the public API baseline needed zero update (CardProps didn't change) and 'no forbidden module leaked' -- antd's own types still don't escape Card's public .d.ts surface even though antd is now used internally. Confirmed via two consecutive doc-mesh regenerations producing byte-identical output, and a stories regeneration touching no existing story file, that this specific change has zero downstream ripple into docs/generated/meshes or apps/architecture-studio/stories beyond what the prior PreviewCard task already added.

DONE: rebuilt apps/architecture-studio end to end (tsc --noEmit, next build) with the antd-backed Card now underneath EntitySummary and PreviewCard on every real page (Explorer, /lab, /registry) -- clean build, all expected routes generated; inspected /lab's prerendered HTML directly and confirmed real ant-card markup renders where EntitySummary-based trial cards are shown.

DONE: amended (not silently overwrote) packages/ui/DECISIONS.md's existing 'Card atom decision' section with a dated 'Reversed 2026-08-02' addendum recording the owner's stated general motivation, the concrete antd API verified, and the one explicit, accepted, unavoidable cost (loss of the 'no ant- class on Card's own root' guarantee) -- preserving the original decision's reasoning as history rather than deleting it, matching how 'Preview card decision' was written earlier in this same session.
artifacts: packages/ui/src/atoms/card.tsx (rewritten on AntCard internally; CardProps unchanged)
packages/ui/tests/ui.test.mjs (3 tests updated to assert the new real contract, 1 renamed)
packages/ui/DECISIONS.md ('Card atom decision' amended with a dated reversal addendum)
risks: The 'Card never leaks an antd class on its own root' guarantee is gone for good, by construction, as long as Card wraps the real antd Card component -- any future consumer relying on that specific DOM-purity property (none exist today, verified via the test suite) would need to be re-evaluated.
This task only proves the current working tree is internally consistent and passes every local check -- none of this session's uncommitted changes have been committed or pushed yet.
